text:
Maya Nguyen: Quick sync: launch week social plan needs split-test variants + paid boost windows. Need copy A/B, 15s vertical clip, and a gated signup CTA. Who can own creative + ad setup?
Rina Gomez: I can do copy A/B and the two CTA variations. Will write short + long formats for LI and X.
Theo Alvarez: I'll cut a 15s vertical highlight from the keynote footage. Need rough timecodes for the hook.
Ben Cho: I can set up the paid boost in Ads Manager and define the audiences. What's the budget window?
Maya Nguyen: Propose $1k/day for the first 3 days post-launch, then taper. Targeting: devs (interest: ML infra), platform leads, and lookalikes from last webinar.
Rina Gomez: For copy experiments, I want to test: A) product-first headline, B) benchmark-first headline (uses metric). Legal: can we run the benchmark in paid creative?
LegalBot: Benchmarks ok if copy matches cleared language. Provide the source doc in the creative review thread. No cost claims without backup.
Theo Alvarez: Hook timecodes: 00:00-00:05 rapid benchmark stat overlay, 00:05-00:10 feature demo, 00:10-00:15 CTA. Will deliver master + 15s export.
Maya Nguyen: Also need a 1:1 square crop for X card and a vertical 9:16 for paid stories. @Olivia Park can you QC aspect crops?
Olivia Park: Yep. I'll check text safety zones and make sure captions present. Will flag any legal text overlap.
Ben Cho: Audience list: devs_eng, infra_leads, webinar_lookalike_1pct. Will create UTM templates: utm_source=(x|linkedin)_social&utm_campaign=launch_q2_a OR _b depending on variant.
Dana Kim: Can we add a small poll in the X thread asking which feature matters most? Good for engagement and qual research.
Rina Gomez: Love that. I'll draft the poll options and include it as a follow-up reply in the thread (timed ~2 hours after launch).
Maya Nguyen: Assigning ownership: copy (Rina), edit (Theo), paid setup (Ben), crops/QC (Olivia), webhook/lead capture (Sam), legal sign-off (LegalBot). Please update the launch checklist doc when done.
Sam Reed: I'll wire the Zapier webhook to the CRM with tags: campaign=launch_q2 and variant=A/B. Also add slack notification to #inbound-leads with payload snippet: `{"email":"{{email}}","variant":"A"}`.
Olivia Park: For creative review, please upload to the folder /marketing/launch_q2/creative_reviews and tag me.
Rina Gomez: Dropping copy drafts in #marketing-docs by 3pm. Will label files: copy_A.txt and copy_B.txt.
Maya Nguyen: Timing: soft post Mon 09:00 PT (teaser), main launch Tue 10:00 PT, follow-up poll Tue 12:00 PT, paid boost Tue-Wed-Thu. Let's reconvene Wed morning for performance check.
Ben Cho: I'll set UTM parameters accordingly and schedule the boost window. Will also enable link tracking and conversion pixel.
Maya Nguyen: Thanks team. Last note: prioritize clear signup flow for SDRs — tag hot leads (company_size>100 or job_title includes "Head"/"Director"). @Dana will coordinate with SDRs post-launch.
Dana Kim: Got it, will prep routing rules and a 30-minute alert for hot leads.
Maya Nguyen: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers, ping me directly. :rocket:
